title: Recursive Synthesis for Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2608.05466v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: High-quality long-horizon training data for terminal agents is expensive to produce, often costing hundreds to thousands of dollars per task, because each task must keep the instruction, environment, reference solution, and verifier mutually consistent. Human authoring does not scale, and direct generation with large language models (LLMs) often breaks these dependencies. We present Recursive Synthetic Terminal Tasks (RST), a recursive verified synthesis framework for constructing long-horizon terminal-agent tasks at scale. Starting from verified seed tasks, RST extends the reference solution, realigns the verifier and instruction to the new workflow, validates the result in a fresh sandbox, and reuses accepted tasks as seeds for subsequent rounds. translated_title: 面向长时程终端任务的高效递归合成方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.05466v3 公告类型：替换  摘要：为终端智能体生成高质量的长时程训练数据成本高昂，通常每个任务需花费数百至数千美元，因为每个任务必须确保指令、环境、参考解决方案和验证器相互一致。人工编写难以扩展，而直接用大型语言模型（LLMs）生成往往会破坏这些依赖关系。我们提出了递归合成终端任务（RST），这是一种用于大规模构建长时程终端智能体任务的递归验证合成框架。从已验证的种子任务开始，RST扩展参考解决方案，重新调整验证器和指令以适应新的工作流，在全新的沙盒环境中验证结果，并将通过验收的任务作为后续轮次的种子。在十五轮递归过程中，RST生成了37,484个合成的终端智能体任务，每个任务成本约为0.05美元。任务难度随轮次显著增加：参考解决方案的中位数长度从初始的约200步增至第15轮的约2,000步。
tldr: 提出一种递归验证合成框架RST，能够以极低成本（每任务约0.05美元）大规模生成长时程终端智能体训练任务，并随递归轮次显著提升任务难度。
en_tdlr: Proposes a recursive verified synthesis framework (RST) that generates long-horizon terminal-agent training tasks at scale with minimal cost (~$0.05 per task), while significantly increasing task difficulty across recursive rounds.
